title: Wrong‑Offset Ed25519 instruction introspection enables forged approvals
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The program accepts off‑chain approvals by “verifying” an Ed25519 signature via the instruction sysvar: `borrow` expects the previous instruction in the same transaction to be a native Ed25519 verification and then inspects that instruction’s raw data to decide whether the signature is valid.
